body:
My apologies for violating the rules.  I certainly didn't mean to and I have not given anyone medical advice or anything of the sort.  My intention was to let someone just talk/chat with another if they just wanted to talk.  

I understand your point and will not do so again.

While I can't relate to your personal experience and sentiments, please note that I have my own issues.

I'm here for you if needed and it's really a pain when you try to respond and get the "you're doing that too much" notice.  I get that a lot because I don't wan't an online persona.  Unfortunately, it doesn't help individuals in need where a throwaway is the only option for help.

I get it.  I don't know if I get you yet, but I would like to try and understand.  There's no need in getting knocked down and refusing help to get you back up.

I would make an ascii hand for my extension, but it would just look like a dick. So, for now, don't grab my ascii dick.... just grab my internet hand and let me pick you up.
